const DROPS = split("down martian rpf invalid acl_in ttl noroute acl_out exhausted")
struct CommandError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(CommandError(s))
function decimal(s, maxdigits)
    1<=length(s)<=maxdigits && all(c->'0'<=c<='9', s) && (length(s)==1 || first(s)!='0') ?
    parse(Int, s) : nothing
end
function address(s)
    fields=split(s, '.'; keepempty = true)
    length(fields)==4 || return nothing
    a=0
    for field in fields
        x=decimal(field, 3)
        (x===nothing || x>255) && return nothing
        a=256a+x
    end
    a
end
function prefix(s)
    parts=split(s, '/'; keepempty = true)
    length(parts)==2 || return nothing
    a=address(parts[1])
    n=decimal(parts[2], 2)
    a===nothing || n===nothing || n>32 ? nothing : (a, n)
end
network(a, n) = fld(a, 2^(32-n))*2^(32-n)
inprefix(a, n, b) = network(a, n)==network(b, n)
ip(a) = join((mod(fld(a, 2^k), 256) for k in (24, 16, 8, 0)), ".")
cidr(a, n) = "$(ip(a))/$n"
endpoint(a, p) = "$(ip(a)):$p"
flowtext(t) = "$(endpoint(t[2],t[3])) > $(endpoint(t[4],t[5]))"
function requireaddress(s)
    a=address(s)
    a===nothing && fail("bad address $s")
    a
end
function requireprefix(s; acl = false)
    acl && s=="ANY" && return (0, 0)
    p=prefix(s)
    p===nothing && fail("bad prefix $s")
    network(p...)==p[1] || fail("host bits set in $s")
    p
end
function requireint(s, lo, hi, message)
    n=parse(Int, s)
    lo<=n<=hi || fail(message)
    n
end
function portrange(s)
    s=="ANY" && return (0, 65535, "any")
    b=parse.(Int, split(s, '-'))
    lo=first(b)
    hi=last(b)
    lo<=hi<=65535 || fail("bad port range $s")
    lo, hi, lo==hi ? string(lo) : "$lo-$hi"
end
mutable struct Rule
    seq::Int
    action::String
    proto::String
    src::Tuple{Int,Int}
    sports::Tuple{Int,Int,String}
    dst::Tuple{Int,Int}
    dports::Tuple{Int,Int,String}
    established::Bool
    hits::Int
end
mutable struct Pat
    proto::String
    inside::Int
    inport::Int
    port::Int
    used::Int
end
mutable struct Interface
    name::String
    addr::Int
    length::Int
    up::Bool
    outside::Bool
    pool::Int
    rpf::String
    rx::Int
    tx::Int
    drop::Int
    rules::Dict{String,Vector{Rule}}
    defaults::Dict{String,Int}
    pat::Vector{Pat}
end
Interface(n, a, l) = Interface(
    n,
    a,
    l,
    true,
    false,
    0,
    "off",
    0,
    0,
    0,
    Dict("in"=>Rule[], "out"=>Rule[]),
    Dict("in"=>0, "out"=>0),
    Pat[],
)
mutable struct Route
    kind::String
    addr::Int
    length::Int
    iface::Interface
    hop::Union{Nothing,Int}
    metric::Int
    hits::Int
end
notation(r) =
    "$(r.kind) $(cidr(r.addr,r.length))"*(r.hop===nothing ? "" : " via $(ip(r.hop))")*" dev $(r.iface.name) metric $(r.metric)"
struct Forward
    iface::Interface
    proto::String
    port::Int
    inside::Int
    inport::Int
end
const Flow=Tuple{String,Int,Int,Int,Int}
mutable struct Connection
    number::Int
    orig::Flow
    reply::Flow
    inbound::Interface
    outbound::Interface
    state::String
    origcount::Int
    replycount::Int
    used::Int
mutable struct Router
    interfaces::Vector{Interface}
    routes::Vector{Route}
    statics::Vector{Tuple{Int,Int}}
    forwards::Vector{Forward}
    conns::Vector{Connection}
    timeouts::Dict{String,Int}
    clock::Int
    packets::Int
    serial::Int
    counts::Dict{String,Int}
    errors::Int
end
Router() = Router(
    Interface[],
    Route[],
    Tuple{Int,Int}[],
    Forward[],
    Connection[],
    Dict("TCP"=>300, "UDP"=>60, "ICMP"=>30),
    0,
    0,
    0,
    Dict(k=>0 for k in [DROPS; ["forwarded", "local"]]),
    0,
)
function iface(r, name)
    n=findfirst(i->i.name==name, r.interfaces)
    n===nothing && fail("no interface $name")
    r.interfaces[n]
end
localiface(r, a) = findfirst(i->i.addr==a, r.interfaces)
function selectroute(r, a)
    best=nothing
    for route in r.routes
        route.iface.up && inprefix(route.addr, route.length, a) || continue
        if best===nothing ||
           route.length>best.length ||
           route.length==best.length && route.metric<best.metric
            best=route
        end
    end
    best
end
function evaluate!(i, d, t, established)
    isempty(i.rules[d]) && return nothing
    p, s, sp, dst, dp=t
    for rule in i.rules[d]
        rule.proto in ("ANY", p) && inprefix(rule.src..., s) && inprefix(rule.dst..., dst) ||
            continue
        rule.proto in ("TCP", "UDP") &&
            !(rule.sports[1]<=sp<=rule.sports[2] && rule.dports[1]<=dp<=rule.dports[2]) &&
            continue
        rule.established && !established && continue
        rule.hits+=1
        label="acl $(i.name) $d $(rule.seq)"
        return rule.action=="PERMIT" ? nothing :
               rule.action=="DENY" ? "DROP $label" :
               "REJECT $label "*(p=="TCP" ? "tcp-reset" : "icmp-prohibited")
    end
    i.defaults[d]+=1
    "DROP acl $(i.name) $d default"
end
function record!(c, d, flags, clock)
    d=="reply" ? (c.replycount+=1) : (c.origcount+=1)
    c.used=clock
    if c.orig[1]!="TCP"
        d=="reply" && (c.state="REPLIED")
function process!(r, i, p, flags, s, sp, d, dp, ttl)
    !i.up && return "down", "DROP down"
    if any(
        x->inprefix(x[1], x[2], s) || inprefix(x[1], x[2], d),
        ((0, 8), (2130706432, 8), (3758096384, 3)),
    ) || localiface(r, s)!==nothing
        return "martian", "DROP martian"
    t=(p, s, sp, d, dp)
    pure=p=="TCP" && flags=="S"
    c=nothing
    direction=""
    for (j, conn) in enumerate(r.conns)
        dir=conn.orig==t ? "orig" : conn.reply==t ? "reply" : ""
        isempty(dir) && continue
        if conn.state=="CLOSED" && pure
            deleteat!(r.conns, j)
        else
            c=conn
            direction=dir
        end
        break
    verdict=evaluate!(i, "in", t, c!==nothing)
    verdict!==nothing && return "acl_in", verdict
    nd=d
    np=dp
    used=nothing
    if i.outside
        st=findfirst(x->x[2]==d, r.statics)
        if st!==nothing
            nd=r.statics[st][1]
        elseif d==i.addr
            f=findfirst(x->x.iface===i && x.proto==p && x.port==dp, r.forwards)
            m=findfirst(x->x.proto==p && x.port==dp, i.pat)
            if f!==nothing
                nd=r.forwards[f].inside
                np=r.forwards[f].inport
            elseif m!==nothing
                used=i.pat[m]
                nd=used.inside
                np=used.inport
            end
        end
    end
    loc=localiface(r, nd)
    loc!==nothing && return "local", "LOCAL $(r.interfaces[loc].name)"
    ttl==1 && return "ttl", "DROP ttl"
    route=selectroute(r, nd)
    route===nothing && return "noroute", "DROP noroute"
    o=route.iface
    verdict=evaluate!(o, "out", (p, s, sp, nd, np), c!==nothing)
    verdict!==nothing && return "acl_out", verdict
    ns=s
    nsp=sp
    if !i.outside && o.outside
        st=findfirst(x->x[1]==s, r.statics)
        f=findfirst(x->x.iface===o && x.proto==p && x.inside==s && x.inport==sp, r.forwards)
        if st!==nothing
            ns=r.statics[st][2]
        elseif f!==nothing
            ns=o.addr
            nsp=r.forwards[f].port
        elseif o.pool>0
            m=findfirst(x->x.proto==p && x.inside==s && x.inport==sp, o.pat)
            if m===nothing
                port=findfirst(
                    x->!any(y->y.port==x, o.pat) && !any(y->y.iface===o && y.port==x, r.forwards),
                    20000:(19999+o.pool),
                )
                port===nothing && return "exhausted", "DROP exhausted"
                used=Pat(p, s, sp, 19999+port, r.clock)
                push!(o.pat, used)
            else
                used=o.pat[m]
            end
            ns=o.addr
            nsp=used.port
        end
    end
    used!==nothing && (used.used=r.clock)
    if c===nothing
        r.serial+=1
        c=Connection(
            r.serial,
            t,
            (p, nd, np, ns, nsp),
            i,
            o,
            p=="TCP" ? "SYN_SENT" : "UNREPLIED",
            0,
            0,
            r.clock,
            false,
            false,
        )
        push!(r.conns, c)
        direction="new"
    end
    record!(c, direction, flags, r.clock)
    o.tx+=1
    route.hits+=1
    verdict="FORWARD $(o.name) "*(route.hop===nothing ? "direct" : "via $(ip(route.hop))")*" ttl=$(ttl-1)"
    (nd, np)!=(d, dp) && (verdict*=" dnat=$(endpoint(nd,np))")
    (ns, nsp)!=(s, sp) && (verdict*=" snat=$(endpoint(ns,nsp))")
    "forwarded", verdict*" conn=$(c.number) $direction"
function showstate(r, what)
    interfaces=sort(r.interfaces; by = i->i.name)
    elseif what=="CONNS"
        println("show conns count=$(length(r.conns))")
        for c in r.conns
            println(
                "conn $(c.number) $(c.orig[1]) $(flowtext(c.orig)) reply $(flowtext(c.reply)) in=$(c.inbound.name) out=$(c.outbound.name) state=$(c.state) pkts=$(c.origcount)/$(c.replycount) idle=$(r.clock-c.used)",
            )
        end
    else
        dropped=sum(r.counts[k] for k in DROPS)
        forwarded=r.counts["forwarded"]
        localcount=r.counts["local"]
        println(
            "show counters packets=$(forwarded+localcount+dropped) forwarded=$forwarded local=$localcount dropped=$dropped errors=$(r.errors)",
        )
        println("drops ", join(("$k=$(r.counts[k])" for k in DROPS), " "))
        for i in interfaces
            println("iface $(i.name) rx=$(i.rx) tx=$(i.tx) drop=$(i.drop)")
function execute!(r, line)
    words=String.(split(line))
    cmd=words[1]
    a=words[2:end]
    if cmd=="IFACE"
        name, word=a
        any(i->i.name==name, r.interfaces) && fail("duplicate interface $name")
        p=prefix(word)
        (p===nothing || !(8<=p[2]<=30)) && fail("bad prefix $word")
        addr, len=p
        host=addr-network(addr, len)
        host in (0, 2^(32-len)-1) && fail("bad host address $word")
        for i in r.interfaces
            inprefix(i.addr, min(len, i.length), addr) && fail("subnet overlaps $(i.name)")
        end
        i=Interface(name, addr, len)
        push!(r.interfaces, i)
        push!(r.routes, Route("C", network(addr, len), len, i, nothing, 0, 0))
        println("ok iface $name $word network $(cidr(network(addr,len),len))")
    elseif cmd=="ROUTE"
        word, mode, target, m=a
        addr, len=requireprefix(word)
        hop=nothing
        i=nothing
        if mode=="VIA"
            hop=requireaddress(target)
        else
            i=iface(r, target)
        end
        metric=requireint(m, 1, 255, "bad metric $m")
        any(
            x->x.kind=="S" && x.addr==addr && x.length==len && x.iface===i && x.hop==hop,
            r.routes,
        ) && fail("duplicate route $word")
        route=Route("S", addr, len, i, hop, metric, 0)
        push!(r.routes, route)
        println("ok route ", notation(route))
    elseif cmd=="ACL"
        name, d, seq, action, p, src, sports, dst, dports=a[1:9]
        i=iface(r, name)
        n=requireint(seq, 1, 9999, "bad sequence $seq")
        s=requireprefix(src; acl = true)
        sp=portrange(sports)
        dest=requireprefix(dst; acl = true)
        dp=portrange(dports)
        p in ("ICMP", "ANY") && (sports!="ANY" || dports!="ANY") && fail("ports not allowed for $p")
        dir=lowercase(d)
        any(x->x.seq==n, i.rules[dir]) && fail("duplicate sequence $seq")
        push!(i.rules[dir], Rule(n, action, p, s, sp, dest, dp, last(a)=="ESTABLISHED", 0))
        sort!(i.rules[dir]; by = x->x.seq)
        println("ok acl $name $dir $seq")
    elseif cmd=="NAT"
        kind=a[1]
        a=a[2:end]
        if kind=="STATIC"
        elseif kind=="OUTSIDE"
        elseif kind=="PAT"
            name, word=a
            i=iface(r, name)
            n=requireint(word, 1, 1000, "bad pool size $word")
            i.pool>0 && fail("pat already on $name")
            i.pool=n
            i.outside=true
            println("ok nat pat $name $(ip(i.addr)) 20000-$(19999+n)")
        else
            name, p, word, insideword, inword=a
            i=iface(r, name)
            port=requireint(word, 1, 65535, "bad port $word")
            inside=requireaddress(insideword)
            inport=requireint(inword, 1, 65535, "bad port $inword")
            i.outside || fail("interface $name not outside")
            localiface(r, inside)!==nothing && fail("address $insideword is local")
            any(f->f.iface===i && f.proto==p && f.port==port, r.forwards) &&
                fail("duplicate forward $name $p $word")
            push!(r.forwards, Forward(i, p, port, inside, inport))
            println("ok nat forward $name $p $word $insideword:$inword")
    elseif cmd=="PACKET"
        name, p, flags, sw, spw, dw, dpw, tw=a
        i=iface(r, name)
        p!="TCP" && flags!="-" && fail("flags not allowed for $p")
        s=requireaddress(sw)
        sp=requireint(spw, 0, 65535, "bad port $spw")
        d=requireaddress(dw)
        dp=requireint(dpw, 0, 65535, "bad port $dpw")
        ttl=requireint(tw, 1, 255, "bad ttl $tw")
        r.packets+=1
        i.rx+=1
        reason, verdict=process!(r, i, p, flags=="-" ? "" : flags, s, sp, d, dp, ttl)
        r.counts[reason]+=1
        reason in DROPS && (i.drop+=1)
        println("#$(r.packets) $p $flags $sw:$spw > $dw:$dpw $verdict")
    elseif cmd=="SHOW"
        showstate(r, a[1])
function main()
    r=Router()
    n=parse(Int, readline())
    for _ in 1:n
        line=readline()
        try
            execute!(r, line)
        catch e
            e isa CommandError || rethrow()
            r.errors+=1
            println("error: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
